params:
  n_core: null
  input_dir: "../results/core-genes-pymlst"    # folder of the pipeline outputs: core_genes_index.tsv, core_genes.tsv, pymlst/
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

#' Read the distance matrix of `wgMLST distance` (first line: the number of strains, then one row per strain)
#'
#' @param f the distance file
#' @return a numeric matrix, its rows and columns named by the genomes
read_pymlst_distance <- function(f) {
	m <- read_tsv(f, skip = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(X1 = "c", .default = "d")) %>% 
	  column_to_rownames("X1") %>% 
	  as.matrix()
	colnames(m) <- rownames(m)
	m
}
```


```{r}
genomes <- read_tsv(
  fs::path(params$input_dir, "core_genes_index.tsv"), 
  col_types = cols(index = "c", genome = "c")
) %>% dplyr::rename(genome_name=genome,genome=index)

dist_mat <- read_pymlst_distance(fs::path(params$input_dir, "pymlst/distance.tsv"))
rownames(dist_mat) <- genomes$genome_name[match(rownames(dist_mat),genomes$genome)]
colnames(dist_mat) <- genomes$genome_name[match(colnames(dist_mat),genomes$genome)]
if (nrow(dist_mat) > 2) {
	dist_mat <- dist_mat[hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = "ward.D2")$order,]
	dist_mat <- dist_mat[,rownames(dist_mat)]
}
```

`r nrow(dist_mat)` genomes, typed with pyMLST (wgMLST) on their core genes (genes found in at least `r params$n_core` genomes).

# Summary

The genes of the clusters of reciprocal hits (one gene per genome in each cluster), and the core template genes (one
per core cluster: the template of the pyMLST database).

```{r summary}
genes <- read_tsv(
  fs::path(params$input_dir, "core_genes.tsv"), 
  col_types = cols(genome = "c", is_core_template = "l", .default = "c")
) %>% 
  left_join(genomes)

genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarize(
    Genomes = n_distinct(genome),
    Genes = lengths(genome),
    `Gene clusters` = n_distinct(cluster_id),
    `Core template genes` = sum(is_core_template)
  ) |>
	knitr::kable(caption = "All the genomes")

genes |>
	group_by(Index=genome,Genome = genome_name) |>
	summarise(Genes = n(), `Core template genes` = sum(is_core_template)) |>
	arrange(as.integer(Index)) |>
	knitr::kable(caption = "Genes of each genome")
```

# Distance matrix

The number of core genes with different alleles in each pair of genomes (genomes ordered by an average linkage clustering).

```{r distance_heatmap}
plot_ly(
	x = colnames(dist_mat), y = rownames(dist_mat), z = dist_mat, type = "heatmap",
	colorscale = "YlOrRd", reversescale = TRUE, colorbar = list(title = "Distance"),
	text = array(
	  sprintf("%s - %s<br>distance: %s", rownames(dist_mat)[row(dist_mat)], colnames(dist_mat)[col(dist_mat)],dist_mat),
	  dim(dist_mat)
	),
	hoverinfo = "text",
	texttemplate = "%{z}"    # the distance in each cell
) |>
	layout(
		xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = 90),
		yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed", scaleanchor = "x")    # square cells
	)
```

# Allele matrix

The allele of each core gene in each genome: in each gene, the alleles are numbered by decreasing frequency
(1: the most frequent allele), white for a gene missing in the genome. Hover a cell for its pyMLST allele id.

```{r allele_heatmap}
alleles <- read_tsv(fs::path(params$input_dir, "pymlst/mlst.tsv"), col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
	rename(gene_uid = 1) |>
	pivot_longer(-gene_uid, names_to = "genome", values_to = "allele") |>
  left_join(genomes) |>
	group_by(gene_uid) |>
	mutate(rank = match(allele, names(sort(table(allele), decreasing = TRUE)))) |>    # NA for a missing gene
	ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    gene_uid = as_factor(gene_uid),
    genome_name = fct_relevel(genome_name, rownames(dist_mat))
  )

local({
  z_mat <- alleles %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols=genome_name,names_from = gene_uid,values_from = rank) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("genome_name") %>% 
    as.matrix()
  text_mat <- alleles %>% 
    mutate(text = sprintf("gene: %s<br>genome: %s<br>allele: %s", gene_uid, genome_name, replace_na(allele, "missing"))) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols=genome_name,names_from = gene_uid,values_from = text) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("genome_name") %>% 
    as.matrix()
  plot_ly(
  	x = colnames(z_mat), y = rownames(z_mat), z = z_mat, text = text_mat, hoverinfo = "text",
  	type = "heatmap", colorscale = "Viridis", colorbar = list(title = "Allele rank")
  ) |>
  	layout(
  		xaxis = list(title = "Core gene", showticklabels = length(genes) <= 100),
  		yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed")
  	)  
})
```

# Minimum spanning tree

The minimum spanning tree of the genomes for the pyMLST distances (edges labelled by the distance).

```{r mst, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
# a distance of 0 (identical genomes) would be no edge in the adjacency graph: add a tiny weight to all the edges
g0 <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(dist_mat + 1e-9, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
mst_g <- as_tbl_graph(igraph::mst(g0)) |>
	activate(edges) |>
	mutate(distance = round(weight))

ggraph(mst_g, layout = "stress") +
	geom_edge_link(aes(label = distance), angle_calc = "along", label_dodge = unit(2.5, "mm"), color = "grey50") +
	geom_node_point(size = 6, color = "steelblue") +
	geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
	theme_graph(base_family = "sans")
```
